**Severity:** error · **Area:** Resume (`RV2xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads one of:

```text
{file} matches both the Rivet compiler and {framework}({ include }) — pick one owner
```

```text
{file} matches both {framework}({ include }) and {other}({ include }) — pick one owner
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Give the module one owner: rename it with the framework suffix (`Counter.react.tsx`) and drop it from the Rivet `include`, or narrow one bridge's `include` / add the file to its `exclude`.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
// vite.config.ts: rivet({ include: ["src/**"], bridges: [react({ include: ["src/widgets/**"] })] })
export function Chart() { return <div />; }
```

```tsx prefer
// vite.config.ts: rivet({ include: ["src/pages/**"], bridges: [react({ include: ["src/widgets/**"] })] })
export function Chart() { return <div />; }
```

## When it is reported

Vite plugin (`rivet({ bridges })`, framework bridges spec §4.1). Ownership: `.vue` / `.svelte` files, `*.react|preact|solid.tsx|jsx`, a leading `@jsxImportSource` pragma of the framework, each bridge's `include` / `exclude` (folders as globs, npm packages by import specifier); everything else is Rivet.
